scripts.build: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then varlock run -- vp build; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run build; fi
scripts.build:ssr: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then varlock run -- vp build && varlock run -- vp build --ssr; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run build:ssr; fi
scripts.check: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then composer lint && composer test:app; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run check; fi
scripts.dev: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then varlock run -- vp dev; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec app bun run dev; fi
scripts.db:fresh: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then php artisan app:db-fresh --no-interaction; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run db:fresh; fi
scripts.db:seed: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then php artisan app:db-seed --no-interaction; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run db:seed; fi
scripts.docker:logs: varlock run -- docker compose logs -f app
scripts.glados: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then bun run env:check && composer validate --strict && composer test:lint && composer test:types && bun run build:ssr && composer test:app && composer test:browser; else bun run env:check && bun run secrets:scan && bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run glados; fi
scripts.shodan: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then composer test:app; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app composer test:app; fi
scripts.lint: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-strip-types' vp fmt resources/ && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-strip-types' vp lint --fix; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run lint; fi
scripts.test:lint: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-strip-types' vp fmt --check resources/ && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-strip-types' vp lint; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run test:lint; fi
scripts.test:lint:ci: NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-strip-types' vp fmt --check resources/ && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-strip-types' vp lint
scripts.test:browser: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then bun run build && composer test:browser; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run test:browser; fi
scripts.test:types: if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then tsc --noEmit; else bunx varlock run -- docker compose exec -T app bun run test:types; fi
